results.snippet: Use time.monotonic() to measure elapsed time for a rate limiter.

pages.https://example.test/token-bucket: Token bucket: keep `tokens` and `last_refill`. On each request add (now - last_refill) * rate tokens, cap at capacity, then take one token or reject.
